Senior NetSuite Techno-Functional Consultant

Work Arrangement: Remote
Engagement Type: Long-term 1099 independent contractor
Initial Workload: Approximately 5–10 hours per week
Growth Potential: May increase to approximately 20 hours and eventually 30+ hours per week
Compensation: Competitive Competitive Parity? No. Competitive hourly 1099 rate based on qualifications and scope

Position Overview

Driggs Search International is recruiting a Senior NetSuite Techno-Functional Consultant for a retained client, a boutique consulting firm specializing in complex NetSuite environments.

This opportunity is designed for a consultant who can lead client discovery, understand business and accounting requirements, design the technical architecture, and remain hands-on throughout development, implementation, deployment, and go-live.

This is not a traditional W-2 position. It is a long-term 1099 consulting relationship that begins gradually while the consultant learns the firm’s methodology and demonstrates their ability to work effectively with clients.

Engagement Model

Consultants typically begin with approximately 5–10 hours per week during onboarding. The workload may increase to approximately 20 hours per week and eventually 30+ hours as the consultant becomes integrated and takes on additional client work.

The initial hours are a starting point rather than the intended long-term workload. However, the timing and number of hours are not guaranteed and depend on performance, client demand, and mutual fit.

This position does not include traditional employee benefits, and there is no guaranteed conversion to W-2 employment.

Responsibilities

Lead client discovery and requirements-gathering sessions
Understand business processes, accounting requirements, technical constraints, and existing NetSuite architecture
Translate business needs into scalable technical and functional solutions
Develop solution designs, technical specifications, implementation plans, and supporting documentation
Design, develop, test, deploy, and support NetSuite customizations
Develop and optimize SuiteScript 2.x and 2.1 solutions
Configure SuiteFlow, SuiteBuilder, custom records, forms, fields, workflows, roles, and permissions
Architect integrations using REST, SOAP, SuiteTalk, RESTlets, APIs, and middleware platforms
Create SuiteAnalytics workbooks, saved searches, dashboards, reports, and performance metrics
Support NetSuite OneWorld and multi-subsidiary environments
Diagnose performance problems, technical debt, broken processes, and ineffective customizations
Explain complex technical recommendations clearly to executives and nontechnical stakeholders
Independently own projects from discovery through implementation, go-live, and post-launch stabilization
Collaborate remotely while maintaining consistent communication and meeting agreed deadlines

Required Qualifications

At least seven years of hands-on NetSuite experience preferred
Advanced SuiteScript 2.x or 2.1 development capabilities
Client-facing NetSuite consulting experience
Demonstrated ownership of NetSuite projects from discovery through implementation or go-live
NetSuite OneWorld and multi-subsidiary experience
SuiteFlow, SuiteBuilder, SuiteAnalytics, saved searches, and custom-record experience
REST, SOAP, SuiteTalk, RESTlet, API, and third-party integration experience
Understanding of script governance, execution contexts, performance optimization, logging, and error handling
Ability to independently diagnose complex NetSuite problems and recommend practical solutions
Ability to communicate effectively with executives, accounting teams, operational leaders, and developers
Availability to support U.S.-based clients and meetings
Legal authorization to accept a direct 1099 engagement without employment sponsorship

Functional Knowledge

Qualified candidates should have practical knowledge in several of the following areas:

General Ledger and financial reporting
Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable
Order to Cash
Procure to Pay
Revenue recognition
Intercompany accounting
Period close
CRM and order management
Inventory and distribution
Manufacturing or warehouse operations
Multi-currency and multi-subsidiary environments

Preferred Qualifications

Celigo, Boomi, MuleSoft, or comparable integration-platform experience
NetSuite certifications
SuiteCloud Development Framework
Git and CI/CD deployment practices
Solution-architecture or technical-lead experience
Experience mentoring developers or reviewing technical work
Experience repairing or redesigning ineffective NetSuite implementations
Responsible use of AI-assisted development, testing, documentation, or system analysis

Outside Employment and Conflicts

Candidates currently employed by Oracle, a NetSuite partner, or another consulting organization must confirm that outside consulting is permitted.

Any required conflict-of-interest disclosure, manager approval, or other authorization must be completed before beginning work. Consultants must not use another employer’s time, equipment, confidential information, or client relationships.

Interview Process

Initial qualification interview with Driggs Search International
Written candidate questionnaire
Short recorded video responses
4 4. Virtual interview with the Technology Practice Lead
Practical technical project
Reference and background review
Offer and start-date determinationResponsiveness, communication, and timely completion of each step are part of the evaluation process.

Application Requirements

Please submit your current resume and include brief answers to the following:

How many years have you worked directly with NetSuite?
How many years have you used SuiteScript 2.x or 2.1?
Have you personally led a client engagement from discovery through go-live?
Can you accept a direct 1099 engagement without sponsorship?
Does the initial 5–10-hour weekly schedule work for you?
Could you eventually support 20–30+ hours if the relationship grows?
Does your current employer permit outside consulting?
What hourly rate are you targeting?

Candidates seeking only a traditional W-2 position, guaranteed full-time hours, employer-sponsored benefits, or guaranteed W-2 conversion will not be aligned with this opportunity.
